instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Bonsai/Blender graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal or a shell; do not use the Blender Python console, Text editor scripts, Python, IfcOpenShell, shell commands, or any helper script/macro to directly generate or edit the deliverable file. Use only Bonsai/Blender native GUI tools, panels, menus, dialogs, and built-in save commands. Open the provided init.ifc office layout in Bonsai. Using the Bonsai GUI, add room finish and area data directly to the IFC spaces, then save the completed IFC4 model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. Do not create or export a CSV, spreadsheet, schedule file, report, or helper script; the required data must be stored in the IFC model itself. The result should contain one project, one building storey, five spaces, seven walls, one slab, four doors, three windows, seven opening elements, seven void relationships, and seven fill relationships. Do not include building element proxies or furnishing elements. Every door and window should fill one opening, and every such opening should void an IfcWall. Name the spaces Lobby, Office A, Office B, Meeting, and WC. For each space, use the GUI property/quantity panels to add an EPset_FMFinish property set with RoomNumber, FloorFinish, WallFinish, and CeilingFinish, plus a Qto_SpaceBaseQuantities NetFloorArea quantity. Use these required space records: Lobby RoomNumber 101, FloorFinish Polished Concrete, WallFinish Painted GWB, CeilingFinish Acoustic Tile, NetFloorArea 10.08; Office A RoomNumber 102, FloorFinish Carpet Tile, WallFinish Painted GWB, CeilingFinish Acoustic Tile, NetFloorArea 23.04; Office B RoomNumber 103, FloorFinish Carpet Tile, WallFinish Painted GWB, CeilingFinish Acoustic Tile, NetFloorArea 33.84; Meeting RoomNumber 104, FloorFinish Vinyl Plank, WallFinish Painted GWB, CeilingFinish Acoustic Tile, NetFloorArea 14.96; and WC RoomNumber 105, FloorFinish Ceramic Tile, WallFinish Moisture Board, CeilingFinish Painted Ceiling, NetFloorArea 15.64. Area values may vary by at most 0.05 square meters. Other visual details may vary.
